targets.rawSql: SELECT state FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'

SELECT CASE WHEN paper_clock_started_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paper_clock_started_at)) / 86400)::int) END AS paper_clock_day FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'
SELECT ROUND(promotion_score::numeric, 3) FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, venue AS chain, COUNT(*) AS count FROM signals WHERE bot_id='copy' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT exit_at AS time, SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (ORDER BY exit_at) AS pnl_cum FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND exit_at >= '2026-06-07' ORDER BY exit_at

panels.title: no_fill rate per day (pipeline health)
panels.description: Daily % of paper trade attempts that failed to fill (Pump.fun pre-grad with no Jupiter route + no Birdeye price, Birdeye quota exhaustion, etc.). 0% = healthy. Any spike = investigate the venue/quote layer immediately. (Calibration ratio panel removed — will return when Build B shadow execution ships.)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='no_fill')::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS no_fill_pct FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH slip AS (SELECT (sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps')::float AS bps FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode IN ('paper','shadow') AND sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps' IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') SELECT CASE WHEN bps < 5 THEN '0-5' WHEN bps < 10 THEN '5-10' WHEN bps < 25 THEN '10-25' WHEN bps < 50 THEN '25-50' WHEN bps < 100 THEN '50-100' ELSE '100+' END AS bucket, MIN(bps) AS sort_key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM slip GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sort_key

SELECT (sim_metadata->>'cluster_size') AS cluster_size, COUNT(*) AS count FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND sim_metadata->>'cluster_size' IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1::int
SELECT ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(size_usd), 0) / 10000.0 * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open'
SELECT ROUND(AVG((sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps')::float)::numeric, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps' IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'

SELECT id, asset, venue AS chain, direction, entry_price, size_usd, entry_at, sim_metadata->>'cluster_size' AS cluster_size FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' ORDER BY entry_at DESC
SELECT halted_at, halt_type, severity, reason, resumed_at FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC

panels.title: Wallet leaderboard — PnL attribution (top by total PnL)
panels.description: Equal-share attribution per cluster. Use this to identify which wallets in the pool are predictive vs noise. Bottom-of-leaderboard wallets are pruning candidates after ≥5 attributed trades.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wa.wallet_address, wa.chain, COUNT(*) AS n_trades, ROUND(SUM(wa.attributed_pnl_usd)::numeric, 2) AS total_pnl_usd, ROUND(AVG(wa.attributed_pnl_pct)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pct, ROUND(MAX(wa.attributed_pnl_pct)::numeric, 2) AS best_pct, ROUND(MIN(wa.attributed_pnl_pct)::numeric, 2) AS worst_pct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wa.attributed_pnl_usd > 0) AS wins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wa.attributed_pnl_usd <= 0) AS losses, ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wa.attributed_pnl_usd > 0)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS win_rate_pct FROM wallet_attributions wa JOIN trades t ON t.id = wa.trade_id WHERE wa.bot_id='copy' AND t.exit_at >= '2026-06-07' GROUP BY wa.wallet_address, wa.chain ORDER BY total_pnl_usd DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Active wallets (≥1 attributed trade)
panels.description: How many of the 119-wallet pool have actually contributed to a paper trade. Low number = pool curation could be refined.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wa.wallet_address) AS active_wallets FROM wallet_attributions wa JOIN trades t ON t.id = wa.trade_id WHERE wa.bot_id='copy' AND t.exit_at >= '2026-06-07'

panels.title: Total attributed PnL
panels.description: Sum of all per-wallet attributions. Should equal sum of paper trade pnl_usd (sanity check). Color: green > 0, yellow -500 to 0, red < -500.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(wa.attributed_pnl_usd)::numeric, 2) FROM wallet_attributions wa JOIN trades t ON t.id = wa.trade_id WHERE wa.bot_id='copy' AND t.exit_at >= '2026-06-07'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(wa.cluster_size)::numeric, 2) FROM wallet_attributions wa JOIN trades t ON t.id = wa.trade_id WHERE wa.bot_id='copy' AND t.exit_at >= '2026-06-07'

panels.title: Wallets with ≥5 trades
panels.description: Wallets with enough attributed history to be candidates for pruning decisions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wa.wallet_address FROM wallet_attributions wa JOIN trades t ON t.id = wa.trade_id WHERE wa.bot_id='copy' AND t.exit_at >= '2026-06-07' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) sub

panels.title: Wallet pool by tier
panels.description: Active wallets feed cluster detector; watch wallets are monitored but not used. Pruned wallets are unsubscribed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tier AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM wallet_pool GROUP BY tier ORDER BY CASE tier WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'watch' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

panels.title: Active wallets — sorted by events_30d (top of pool)
panels.description: Active-tier wallets sorted by recent webhook event volume. Bottom of this list = first candidates for demotion when below 10 events / 30d threshold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT address, events_30d, events_total, last_event_at, last_attribution_at, pinned, source, added_at FROM wallet_pool WHERE tier='active' ORDER BY events_30d DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 75

panels.title: Daily wallet pool transitions
panels.description: Count of promote/demote/drop events from the daily cron. Healthy steady-state = small numbers (1-5/day). Spikes worth investigating.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length((payload->>'promoted')::jsonb), 0) AS promoted, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length((payload->>'demoted')::jsonb), 0) AS demoted, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length((payload->>'dropped')::jsonb), 0) AS dropped, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length((payload->>'swapped')::jsonb), 0) AS swapped FROM audit_log WHERE event_type='wallet_pool_daily_transitions' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top watch-tier candidates (promotion candidates)
panels.description: Watch-tier wallets sorted by recent activity. Anything with events_7d ≥ 5 will be promoted by next daily cron (if WR passes / null).

targets.rawSql: WITH events_7d AS (SELECT wallet_address, COUNT(*) AS n7d FROM wallet_events_log WHERE event_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1) SELECT wp.address, COALESCE(e.n7d, 0) AS events_7d, wp.events_30d, wp.last_event_at, wp.source, wp.added_at FROM wallet_pool wp LEFT JOIN events_7d e ON e.wallet_address = wp.address WHERE wp.tier='watch' ORDER BY COALESCE(e.n7d, 0) DESC, wp.events_30d DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Days remaining in primary window
panels.description: Auto-extends to 90d total if N target not reached.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (kill_criteria_status->'window'->>'days_remaining_primary')::int FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'
SELECT (kill_criteria_status->>'n')::int FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'
SELECT (kill_criteria_status->>'wr')::float FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'
SELECT (kill_criteria_status->>'net_pnl_pct')::float FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'

panels.title: Active kill triggers
panels.description: Empty = no criteria fired. Each entry = one alert that fired this window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(kill_criteria_status->>'kill_triggers', '[]') FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy'
